metadata.order: Per workload: same-process isolated bundles, alternating AB/BA batches

workloads.name: core/loop
workloads.source:
-- A counting loop: the cost of the loop itself and integer addition.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  put 0 into i
  repeat while i < n
    add 1 to i
    add i to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: messaging/sends

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install partner bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- Sends to another Script, each waiting for its reply: one send, one Run in
-- the receiver, and one suspend and resume of the sender.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    send echo with i to partner and wait
    add it to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: messaging/parents

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install parents bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- Sends to a leaf Host Object that has no Owning Script, so each climbs the
-- Message Path through its parents to this Script, which owns the root.
on ping x
  return x
end ping

on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    send ping with i to leaf and wait
    add it to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: messaging/joins

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install partner bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- Joins of eight sends to another Script: starting each Join Member, and one
-- suspend and resume for the whole Join.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    wait for all
      repeat for each j in 1..8
        send echo with i to partner and wait
      end repeat
    end wait
    repeat for each answer in it
      add answer to total
    end repeat
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: messaging/suspend

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.

workloads.source:
-- A zero wait in every iteration: the Run suspends, and the next Pump
-- resumes it, with no Host Operation involved.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    wait 0 s
    add i to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

-- use loops, Maps, Lists, text and a try. Its Run calls each one once.

function step1 x
  put {id: x, label: "item 1 of " & x, tags: [x, x + 1]} into record
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each t in record's tags
    if t > 1 then
      add t to total
    else
      subtract 1 from total
    end if
  end repeat
  try
    if total < 0 then throw {code: "negative 1"}
  catch {code: c}
    add the length of c to total
  end try
  return total + the length of record's label
end step1

workloads.name: lifecycle/restore

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install restore bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- The `restore` Host fills the rows once, then each Run saves the Group,
-- restores it, and delivers `run` to the restored Script, which reads them.
script variable rows = []

on fill n
  put [] into rows
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put {id: i, name: "row " & i, tags: [i, i * 2]} after rows
  end repeat
end fill

on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each row in rows
    add row's id to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: lifecycle/rollback

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install suspending bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- N Runs that each change a Script Variable and then start a Join one member
-- wider than MaxJoin. Each Limit Fault rolls its Segment back, so `count`
-- ends at 0 again. The members are suspending Host calls, so the 16 that
-- start before the fault leave no work in another Script.
script variable count = 0

on fill
  add 1 to count
  wait for all
    repeat for each i in 1..17
      ask host to later i and wait
    end repeat
  end wait
end fill

on run n
  put 0 into faults
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    try
      send fill to me and wait
    catch {code: "send failed", reason: "limit fault"}
      add 1 to faults
    end try
  end repeat
  return faults + count
end run
